title: Signal: Node.js stack frame disclosed in a response
scope: Single response body: confirm no Node.js stack frame with a file, line, and column is returned.
limitations: Pattern on one body: a Node.js trace quoted in a help article can match. Development output and production exposure look the same.

observation.body: Error handled; see the server log for details.

fpNotes: Quoted traces in documentation are the common false positive.
